verdict.rationale: Raygun documents ignore/mute rules (ignore by time period, occurrence count, or custom rule) which directly address alert fatigue, and integrates with PagerDuty for incident routing. However, there is no evidence of spike protection or per-key rate limiting to throttle notification volume during a bad deploy. Missing for 10: spike protection mechanism, per-key/per-source rate limiting, and independent confirmation these mute rules prevent mass paging.
